verdict_scope: Accept of the N0/G-NUM stop-rule closure (reviews/N0-review-lead-audit.json stop_rule: 4th resolution / F0 re-bind / one independent replication verdict) at the pinned rev3 hash, based on an independent hash audit, an independent recomputation of every declared fit statistic, a live 12-rung re-measurement under a frozen-module hash guard, and a new from-scratch fourth-scheme arm. Binds only to the pinned bytes; any later rev3 edit voids it. Not a gate verdict: G-NUM authority remains Astra / lead-audit.
independence: The reviewer authored numerics/tests/flat_wave_replication.py and numerics/protocol/n0_fixed_dt_certification.py, which are rev3's frozen module and certification basis. Solver-independent evidence therefore rests on worker-046 (from-scratch re-execution, SUPPORTED 8/8), worker-057 (re-analysis, REPRODUCED) and worker-081 (adjudication accept); this review audits those artifacts for existence, hash and verdict, and independently recomputes the arithmetic and re-measures the rungs from the pinned module. This limitation is also recorded as finding F-06 and is material to how much weight this accept should carry.

findings.label: stop-rule closure verified at one hash
findings.detail: rev3 da7c360719950f7e declares and delivers all three stop-rule items: (a) four rungs per scheme at fixed dt = 1e-4 (dr 0.2/0.1/0.05/0.025), (b) class binding re-derived against research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml#0abb9ed8a961 (revision 5, hash measured now), (c) three hash-bound independent verdicts (worker-046 SUPPORTED 8/8, worker-057 REPRODUCED, worker-081 adjudication accept). All 11 paths rev3 cites re-hash to their declared sha256.

findings.label: declared statistics reproduce independently
findings.detail: Using an independent least-squares routine on rev3's declared per-rung l2 errors, fit orders, least-squares standard errors, pair orders, R5 deltas (half-range/SE rule), monotonicity and band membership all recompute to <= 1e-9 of the declared values for cnfd 1.9998635927240203, cnfem 1.9999163079874884, lffd 1.999943173893314; cross-scheme max|dp| recomputes to 7.958116929374093e-05 against the 0.25 floor.

findings.label: all 12 fixed-dt rungs re-measured from the frozen module
findings.detail: Live re-run of every certification row (3 schemes x 4 rungs) from numerics/tests/flat_wave_replication.py#8ade1cdc163ea420 under a before/after hash guard reproduced all 12 declared l2 errors to relative tolerance 1e-12; the module hash was identical before import, after import and after the run.

findings.label: new fourth solver family also measures p=2 at fixed dt
findings.detail: A from-scratch RK4 + 3-point-FD arm (not imported from the frozen module; it uses the exact psi_t initial velocity instead of the shared Taylor start) gives p = 1.9999362821051558 (least-squares SE 2.535e-05), monotone on dr 0.2/0.1/0.05/0.025 at dt = 1e-4, |p - p_lffd| = 6.89e-06. Pre-registered criteria (monotone, |p-2| <= 0.3, |p-p_lffd| <= 0.05) all met. This is corroborating evidence, not a refutation path.

findings.label: independent verdict artifacts are not in the hash registry
findings.detail: artifacts/worker-046/n0_fixed_dt_independent/verification.json, artifacts/worker-057/n0_fixeddt_verify/report.json and artifacts/worker-081/n0_c8_adjudication_rev2/adjudication.json are absent from runtime/state/artifact_hashes.json (registry snapshot 2026-09-12T00:57). Their disk bytes match rev3's declared hashes. PROTOCOL rule 2 requires a registry sha256 plus a reviewer verdict before any node promotion, so the controller should register them (or record why not) before acting on this package.

findings.label: reviewer conflict of interest, disclosed
findings.detail: deepseek-flash-13 authored the frozen replication module and the fixed-dt certification basis that rev3 certifies. This accept therefore attests reproducibility, arithmetic and bookkeeping at the pinned hash, and does NOT supply reviewer-independent numerical confirmation; that remains worker-046's from-scratch run. If the controller requires an accept from an agent with no authorship stake in the certification basis, this review should not be the one that closes the node verdict.

findings.detail: (a) worker-057 A4b: the citation token 'section 3.4' resolves only by convention to CONVERGENCE_PROTOCOL.md section 3 item 4; (b) the protocol at 1e6cdf04d7a24313 remains contested (w067 revise, w081 revise vs 3 accepts, with the withdrawn-accept counting issue recorded in rev3 review_state_at_generation); (c) the constant-CFL ladders are labelled mixed-order and are not treated as spatial evidence here. None of these is resolved or altered by this review.
